Let (K_{A}) be the circle, other than (N), that passes through B′ and C′ and touches (I_{A}), and define (K_{B}) and (K_{C}) cyclically. Let (K) be the circle externally tangent to (K_{A}), (K_{B}), (K_{C}), and let (L) be the circle externally tangent to (I_{A}), (I_{B}), (I_{C}). Then X_5213 = (K)∩(L).
